_comment: Copy to cases.local.json and edit for YOUR registered vaults. Keyed by vault name (as registered); each case asserts the resolver lands on a known component. cases.local.json is gitignored so your org's component names never get committed.

demo.note: gibberish resolves to none, never a fabricated guess
regression: common words like 'nothing' fuzzy-match short api-names (~note) ~0.81; must stay below NONE_THRESHOLD, never a junk ambiguous list
